1.text: In tha eighth month, in tha second year of Darius, came tha word of tha LORD 2 Zechariah, tha son of Berechiah, tha son of Iddo tha prophet, sayin,
Tha LORD has been sore displeased wit ur fathers.
Therefore say u 2 ’em, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Turn y’all 2 me, says tha LORD of hosts, N I will turn 2 u, says tha LORD of hosts.

Be y’all not as ur fathers, 2 whom tha former prophets have cried, sayin, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Turn y’all now from ur evil ways, N from ur evil doings: but dey did not hear, nor listen 2 me, says tha LORD.
Ur fathers, where r dey? N tha prophets, do dey live 4 ever?

But my words N my statutes, which I commanded my servants tha prophets, did dey not take hold of ur fathers? N dey returned N said, Like as tha LORD of hosts thought 2 do 2 us, according 2 our ways, N according 2 our doings, so has he dealt wit us.

Upon tha four N twentieth day of tha eleventh month, which is tha month Sebat, in tha second year of Darius, came tha word of tha LORD 2 Zechariah, tha son of Berechiah, tha son of Iddo tha prophet, sayin,
I saw by night, N look a man ridin upon a red horse, N he stood among tha myrtle trees dat were in tha bottom; N behind him were there red horses, speckled, N white.
Then said I, O my lord, what r dese? N tha angel dat talked wit me said 2 me, I will show u what dese be.
N tha man dat stood among tha myrtle trees answered, dese r dey whom tha LORD has sent 2 walk 2 N fro through tha earth.
N dey answered tha angel of tha LORD dat stood among tha myrtle trees, N said, We have walked 2 N fro through tha earth, N, look, all tha earth sits still, N is at rest.
Then tha angel of tha LORD answered, O LORD of hosts, how long will u not have mercy on Jerusalem N on tha citiez of Judah, against which u have had indignation dese threescore N ten years?
N tha LORD answered tha angel dat talked wit me wit good words N comfortable words.
So tha angel dat communed wit me said 2 me, Cry u, sayin, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; I am jealous 4 Jerusalem N 4 Zion wit a great jealousy.
N I am very sore displeased wit tha heathen dat r at ease: 4 I was but a little displeased, N dey helped forward tha affliction.
Therefore like dis says tha LORD; I am returned 2 Jerusalem wit mercies: my house shall be built in it, says tha LORD of hosts, N a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
Cry yet, sayin, like dis says tha LORD of hosts; My citiez through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; N tha LORD shall yet comfort Zion, N shall yet choose Jerusalem.
Then lifted I up my eyes, N saw, N look four horns.
N I said 2 tha angel dat talked wit me, What be dese? N he answered me, dese r tha horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, N Jerusalem.
N tha LORD showed me four carpenters.

Then said I, What come dese 2 do? N he spoke, sayin, dese r tha horns which have scattered Judah, so dat no man did lift up his head: but dese r come 2 fray ’em, 2 cast out tha horns of tha Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over tha land of Judah 2 scatter it.

2.text: I lifted up my eyes again, N looked, N look a man wit a measuring line in his hand.
Then said I, where go u? N he said 2 me, 2 measure Jerusalem, 2 see what is tha breadth of it, N what is tha length of it.
N, look, tha angel dat talked wit me went forth, N another angel went out 2 meet him,
N said 2 him, Run, speak 2 dis young man, sayin, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls 4 tha crowd of men N cattle in it:
4 I, says tha LORD, will be 2 her a wall of fire round about, N will be tha glory in tha midst of her.
Ho, ho, come forth, N flee from tha land of tha north, says tha LORD: 4 I have spread u abroad as tha four winds of tha heaven, says tha LORD.
Deliver urself, O Zion, dat dwell wit tha daughter of Babylon.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts; After tha glory has he sent me 2 tha nations which spoiled u: 4 he dat touches u touches tha apple of his eye.
4, look, I will shake mine hand upon ’em, N dey shall be a spoil 2 their servants: N y’all shall know dat tha LORD of hosts has sent me.
Sing N rejoice, O daughter of Zion: 4, look, I come, N I will live in tha midst of u, says tha LORD.
N many nations shall be joined 2 tha LORD in dat day, N shall be my people: N I will live in tha midst of u, N u will know dat tha LORD of hosts has sent me 2 u.
N tha LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in tha holy land, N shall choose Jerusalem again.
Be silent, O all flesh, before tha LORD: 4 he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

3.text: N he showed me Joshua tha high priest standin before tha angel of tha LORD, N Satan standin at his right hand 2 resist him.
N tha LORD said 2 Satan, tha LORD rebuke u, O Satan; even tha LORD dat has chosen Jerusalem rebuke u: is not dis a brand plucked out of tha fire?
Now Joshua was clothed wit filthy garments, N stood before tha angel.

N he answered N spoke 2 dose dat stood before him, sayin, Take away tha filthy garments from him. N 2 him he said, look, I have caused thine iniquity 2 pass from u, N I will clothe u wit change of clothing.
N I said, Let ’em set a fair mitre upon his head. So dey set a fair mitre upon his head, N clothed him wit garments. N tha angel of tha LORD stood by.
N tha angel of tha LORD protested 2 Joshua, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; If u will walk in my ways, N if u will keep my charge, then u will also judge my house, N will also keep my courts, N I will give u places 2 walk among dese dat stand by.
Hear now, O Joshua tha high priest, u, N ur fellows dat sit before u: 4 dey r men wondered at: 4, look, I will bring forth my servant tha BRANCH.

4 look tha stone dat I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: look, I will engrave tha graving of it, says tha LORD of hosts, N I will remove tha iniquity of dat land in one day.
In dat day, says tha LORD of hosts, shall y’all call every man his neighbour under tha vine N under tha fig tree.

4.text: N tha angel dat talked wit me came again, N waked me, as a man dat is wakened out of his sleep,

N said 2 me, What see u? N I said, I have looked, N look a candlestick all of gold, wit a bowl upon tha top of it, N his seven lamps thereon, N seven pipes 2 tha seven lamps, which r upon tha top of it:
N two olive trees by it, one upon tha right side of tha bowl, N tha other upon tha left side of it.
So I answered N spoke 2 tha angel dat talked wit me, sayin, What r dese, my lord?
Then tha angel dat talked wit me answered 2 me, know u not what dese be? N I said, No, my lord.
Then he answered N spoke 2 me, sayin, dis is tha word of tha LORD 2 Zerubbabel, sayin, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says tha LORD of hosts.
Who r u, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel u will become a plain: N he shall bring forth tha headstone of it wit shoutings, cryin, Grace, grace 2 it.
Moreover tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Tha hands of Zerubbabel have laid tha foundation of dis house; his hands shall also finish it; N u will know dat tha LORD of hosts has sent me 2 u.

4 who has despised tha day of small things? 4 dey shall rejoice, N shall see tha plummet in tha hand of Zerubbabel wit dose seven; dey r tha eyes of tha LORD, which run 2 N fro through tha whole earth. shall rejoice
Then answered I, N said 2 him, What r dese two olive trees upon tha right side of tha candlestick N upon tha left side of it?
N I answered again, N said 2 him, What be dese two olive branches which through tha two golden pipes empty tha golden oil out of themselves?
N he answered me N said, know u not what dese be? N I said, No, my lord.
Then said he, dese r tha two anointed ones, dat stand by tha Lord of tha whole earth.

5.text: Then I turned, N lifted up my eyes, N looked, N look a flying roll.
N he said 2 me, What see u? N I answered, I see a flying roll; tha length of it is twenty cubits, N tha breadth of it ten cubits.

Then said he 2 me, dis is tha curse dat goes forth over tha face of tha whole earth: 4 every one dat stealeth shall be cut off as on dis side according 2 it; N every one dat swears shall be cut off as on dat side according 2 it.

I will bring it forth, says tha LORD of hosts, N it shall enter in2 tha house of tha thief, N in2 tha house of him dat swears falsely by my name: N it shall remain in tha midst of his house, N shall consume it wit tha timber of it N tha stones of it.
Then tha angel dat talked wit me went forth, N said 2 me, Lift up now ur eyes, N see what is dis dat goes forth.
N I said, What is it? N he said, dis is an ephah dat goes forth. He said moreover, dis is their resemblance through all tha earth.
N, look, there was lifted up a talent of lead: N dis is a woman dat sits in tha midst of tha ephah.
N he said, dis is wickedness. N he cast it in2 tha midst of tha ephah; N he cast tha weight of lead upon tha mouth of it.

Then lifted I up my eyes, N looked, N, look, there came out two women, N tha wind was in their wings; 4 dey had wings like tha wings of a stork: N dey lifted up tha ephah between tha earth N tha heaven.
Then said I 2 tha angel dat talked wit me, where do dese bear tha ephah?
N he said 2 me, 2 build it an house in tha land of Shinar: N it will be established, N set there upon her own base.

6.text: N I turned, N lifted up my eyes, N looked, N, look, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; N tha mountains were mountains of brass.
In tha first chariot were red horses; N in tha second chariot black horses;
N in tha third chariot white horses; N in tha fourth chariot grisled N bay horses.
Then I answered 2 tha angel dat talked wit me, What r dese, my lord?
N tha angel answered 2 me, dese r tha four spirits of tha heavenz, which go forth from standin before tha Lord of all tha earth.
Tha black horses which r in it go forth in2 tha north country; N tha white go forth after ’em; N tha grisled go forth toward tha south country.
N tha bay went forth, N sought 2 go dat dey might walk 2 N fro through tha earth: N he said, Get u hence, walk 2 N fro through tha earth. So dey walked 2 N fro through tha earth.
Then cried he upon me, N spoke 2 me, sayin, look, dese dat go toward tha north country have quieted my spirit in tha north country.
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 me, sayin,
Take of ’em of tha captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, N of Jedaiah, which r come from Babylon, N come u tha same day, N go in2 tha house of Josiah tha son of Zephaniah;
Then take silver N gold, N make crowns, N set ’em upon tha head of Joshua tha son of Josedech, tha high priest;
N speak 2 him, sayin, like dis speaks tha LORD of hosts, sayin, look tha man whose name is tha BRANCH; N he shall grow up out of his place, N he shall build tha temple of tha LORD:
Even he shall build tha temple of tha LORD; N he shall bear tha glory, N shall sit N rule upon his throne; N he shall be a priest upon his throne: N tha counsel of peace shall be between ’em both.
N tha crowns shall be 2 Helem, N 2 Tobijah, N 2 Jedaiah, N 2 Hen tha son of Zephaniah, 4 a memorial in tha temple of tha LORD.

N dey dat r far off shall come N build in tha temple of tha LORD, N y’all shall know dat tha LORD of hosts has sent me 2 u. N dis shall come 2 pass, if y’all will diligently obey tha voice of tha LORD ur God.

7.text: N it happened in tha fourth year of king Darius, dat tha word of tha LORD came 2 Zechariah in tha fourth day of tha ninth month, even in Chisleu;
When dey had sent 2 tha house of God Sherezer N Regem-melech, N their men, 2 pray before tha LORD,
N 2 speak 2 tha priests which were in tha house of tha LORD of hosts, N 2 tha prophets, sayin, Should I weep in tha fifth month, separating myself, as I have done dese so many years?
Then came tha word of tha LORD of hosts 2 me, sayin,
Speak 2 all tha people of tha land, N 2 tha priests, sayin, When y’all fasted N mourned in tha fifth N seventh month, even dose seventy years, did y’all at all fast 2 me, even 2 me?
N when y’all did eat, N when y’all did drink, did not y’all eat 4 y’all, N drink 4 y’all?

Should y’all not hear tha words which tha LORD has cried by tha former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited N in prosperity, N tha citiez of it round about her, when men inhabited tha south N tha plain?
N tha word of tha LORD came 2 Zechariah, sayin,
Like dis speaks tha LORD of hosts, sayin, Execute true judgment, N show mercy N compassions every man 2 his brother:
N oppress not tha widow, nor tha fatherless, tha stranger, nor tha poor; N let none of u imagine evil against his brother in ur heart.
But dey refused 2 listen, N pulled away tha shoulder, N stopped their ears, dat dey should not hear.

Yeah, dey made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest dey should hear tha law, N tha words which tha LORD of hosts has sent in his spirit by tha former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from tha LORD of hosts.
Therefore it is come 2 pass, dat as he cried, N dey would not hear; so dey cried, N I would not hear, says tha LORD of hosts:
But I scattered ’em wit a whirlwind among all tha nations whom dey knew not. like dis tha land was desolate after ’em, dat no man passed through nor returned: 4 dey laid tha pleasant land desolate.

8.text: Again tha word of tha LORD of hosts came 2 me, sayin,
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; I was jealous 4 Zion wit great jealousy, N I was jealous 4 her wit great fury.
Like dis says tha LORD; I am returned 2 Zion, N will live in tha midst of Jerusalem: N Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; N tha mountain of tha LORD of hosts tha holy mountain.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men N old women live in tha streets of Jerusalem, N every man wit his staff in his hand 4 very age.
N tha streets of tha city shall be full of boys N girls playing in tha streets of it.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in tha eyes of tha remnant of dis people in dese days, should it also be marvellous in my eyes? says tha LORD of hosts.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; look, I will save my people from tha east country, N from tha west country;
N I will bring ’em, N dey shall live in tha midst of Jerusalem: N dey shall be my people, N I will be their God, in truth N in righteousness.

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; Let ur hands be strong, y’all dat hear in dese days dese words by tha mouth of tha prophets, which were in tha day dat tha foundation of tha house of tha LORD of hosts was laid, dat tha temple might be built.
4 before dese days there was no hire 4 man, nor any hire 4 beast; neither was there any peace 2 him dat went out or came in because of tha affliction: 4 I set all men every one against his neighbour.
But now I will not be 2 tha residue of dis people as in tha former days, says tha LORD of hosts.

4 tha seed shall be prosperous; tha vine shall give her fruit, N tha ground shall give her increase, N tha heavenz shall give their dew; N I will cause tha remnant of dis people 2 possess all dese things.
N it will happen, dat as y’all were a curse among tha heathen, O house of Judah, N house of Israel; so will I save u, N y’all shall be a blessing: don’t fear, but let ur hands be strong.
4 like dis says tha LORD of hosts; As I thought 2 punish u, when ur fathers provoked me 2 wrath, says tha LORD of hosts, N I repented not:
So again have I thought in dese days 2 do well 2 Jerusalem N 2 tha house of Judah: fear y’all not.
Dese r tha things dat y’all shall do; Speak y’all every man tha truth 2 his neighbour; execute tha judgment of truth N peace in ur gates:
N let none of u imagine evil in ur hearts against his neighbour; N love no false oath: 4 all dese r things dat I hate, says tha LORD.
N tha word of tha LORD of hosts came 2 me, sayin,

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; tha fast of tha fourth month, N tha fast of tha fifth, N tha fast of tha seventh, N tha fast of tha tenth, shall be 2 tha house of Judah joy N gladness, N cheerful feasts; therefore love tha truth N peace.
Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; It shall yet come 2 pass, dat there shall come people, N tha inhabitants of many citiez:
N tha inhabitants of one city shall go 2 another, sayin, Let us go speedily 2 pray before tha LORD, N 2 seek tha LORD of hosts: I will go also.
Yeah, many people N strong nations shall come 2 seek tha LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, N 2 pray before tha LORD.

Like dis says tha LORD of hosts; In dose days it will happen, dat ten men shall take hold out of all languages of tha nations, even shall take hold of tha skirt of him dat is a Jew, sayin, We will go wit u: 4 we have heard dat God is wit u.

9.text: Tha burden of tha word of tha LORD in tha land of Hadrach, N Damascus shall be tha rest of it: when tha eyes of man, as of all tha tribes of Israel, shall be toward tha LORD.
N Hamath also shall border by dat; Tyrus, N Zidon, though it be very wise.
N Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, N heaped up silver as tha dust, N fine gold as tha mire of tha streets.
Look, tha Lord will cast her out, N he will strike her power in tha sea; N she shall be devoured wit fire.
Ashkelon shall see it, N fear; Gaza also shall see it, N be very sorrowful, N Ekron; 4 her expectation shall be ashamed; N tha king shall perish from Gaza, N Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
N a bastard shall live in Ashdod, N I will cut off tha pride of tha Philistines.
N I will take away his blood out of his mouth, N his abominations from between his teeth: but he dat remains, even he, shall be 4 our God, N he shall be as a governor in Judah, N Ekron as a Jebusite.
N I will encamp about mine house because of tha army, because of him dat passes by, N because of him dat returns: N no oppressor shall pass through ’em any more: 4 now have I seen wit my eyes.
Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: look, ur King comes 2 u: he is just, N havin salvation; lowly, N ridin upon an ass, N upon a colt tha foal of an ass.

N I will cut off tha chariot from Ephraim, N tha horse from Jerusalem, N tha battle bow shall be cut off: N he shall speak peace 2 tha heathen: N his dominion shall be from sea even 2 sea, N from tha river even 2 tha ends of tha earth.
As 4 u also, by tha blood of ur covenant I have sent forth ur prisoners out of tha pit in which is no water.
Turn u 2 tha strong hold, y’all prisoners of hope: even 2 day do I declare dat I will render double 2 u;
When I have bent Judah 4 me, filled tha bow wit Ephraim, N raised up ur sons, O Zion, against ur sons, O Greece, N made u as tha sword of a mighty man.
N tha LORD shall be seen over ’em, N his arrow shall go forth as tha lightning: N tha Lord GOD shall blow tha trumpet, N shall go wit whirlwinds of tha south.
Tha LORD of hosts shall defend ’em; N dey shall devour, N subdue wit sling stones; N dey shall drink, N make a noise as through wine; N dey shall be filled like bowls, N as tha corners of tha altar.
N tha LORD their God shall save ’em in dat day as tha flock of his people: 4 dey shall be as tha stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
4 how great is his goodness, N how great is his beauty! corn shall make tha young men cheerful, N new wine tha maids.

10.text: Ask y’all of tha LORD rain in tha time of tha latter rain; so tha LORD shall make bright clouds, N give ’em showers of rain, 2 every one grass in tha field.

4 tha idols have spoken vanity, N tha diviners have seen a lie, N have told false dreams; dey comfort in vain: therefore dey went their way as a flock, dey were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
Mine anger was kindled against tha shepherds, N I punished tha goats: 4 tha LORD of hosts has visited his flock tha house of Judah, N has made ’em as his goodly horse in tha battle.
Out of him came forth tha corner, out of him tha nail, out of him tha battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
N dey shall be as mighty men, which tread down their opps in tha mire of tha streets in tha battle: N dey shall fight, because tha LORD is wit ’em, N tha riders on horses shall be confounded.

N I will strengthen tha house of Judah, N I will save tha house of Joseph, N I will bring ’em again 2 place ’em; 4 I have mercy upon ’em: N dey shall be as though I had not cast ’em off: 4 I am tha LORD their God, N will hear ’em.
N dey of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, N their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yeah, their children shall see it, N be glad; their heart shall rejoice in tha LORD.
I will hiss 4 ’em, N gather ’em; 4 I have redeemed ’em: N dey shall increase as dey have increased.
N I will sow ’em among tha people: N dey shall remember me in far countries; N dey shall live wit their children, N turn again.
I will bring ’em again also out of tha land of Egypt, N gather ’em out of Assyria; N I will bring ’em in2 tha land of Gilead N Lebanon; N place shall not be found 4 ’em.

N he shall pass through tha sea wit affliction, N shall strike tha waves in tha sea, N all tha deeps of tha river shall dry up: N tha pride of Assyria shall be brought down, N tha sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
N I will strengthen ’em in tha LORD; N dey shall walk up N down in his name, says tha LORD.

11.text: Open ur doors, O Lebanon, dat tha fire may devour ur cedars.
Howl, fir tree; 4 tha cedar is fallen; because tha mighty r spoiled: howl, O y’all oaks of Bashan; 4 tha forest of tha vintage is come down.
There is a voice of tha howling of tha shepherds; 4 their glory is spoiled: a voice of tha roaring of young lions; 4 tha pride of Jordan is spoiled.
Like dis says tha LORD my God; Feed tha flock of tha slaughter;
Whose possessors kill ’em, N hold themselves not guilty: N dey dat sell ’em say, Blessed be tha LORD; 4 I am rich: N their own shepherds pity ’em not.

4 I will no more pity tha inhabitants of tha land, says tha LORD: but, look, I will deliver tha men every one in2 his neighbour’s hand, N in2 tha hand of his king: N dey shall strike tha land, N out of their hand I will not deliver ’em.
N I will feed tha flock of slaughter, even u, O poor of tha flock. N I took 2 me two staves; tha one I called Beauty, N tha other I called Bands; N I fed tha flock.
Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; N my soul lothed ’em, N their soul also abhorred me.
Then said I, I will not feed u: dat dat dies, let it die; N dat dat is 2 be cut off, let it be cut off; N let tha rest eat every one tha flesh of another.
N I took my staff, even Beauty, N cut it asunder, dat I might break my covenant which I had made wit all tha people.
N it was broken in dat day: N so tha poor of tha flock dat waited upon me knew dat it was tha word of tha LORD.
N I said 2 ’em, If y’all think good, give me my price; N if not, forbear. So dey weighed 4 my price thirty pieces of silver.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Cast it 2 tha potter: a goodly price dat I was prised at of ’em. N I took tha thirty pieces of silver, N cast ’em 2 tha potter in tha house of tha LORD.
Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, dat I might break tha brotherhood between Judah N Israel.
N tha LORD said 2 me, Take 2 u yet tha instruments of a foolish shepherd.

4, look, I will raise up a shepherd in tha land, which shall not visit dose dat be cut off, neither shall seek tha young one, nor heal dat dat is broken, nor feed dat dat stands still: but he shall eat tha flesh of tha fat, N tear their claws in pieces.
Woe 2 tha idol shepherd dat leaves tha flock! tha sword shall be upon his arm, N upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, N his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

12.text: Tha burden of tha word of tha LORD 4 Israel, says tha LORD, which stretches forth tha heavenz, N lays tha foundation of tha earth, N formeth tha spirit of man within him.
Look, I will make Jerusalem a cup of tremblin 2 all tha people round about, when dey shall be in tha siege both against Judah N against Jerusalem.
N in dat day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone 4 all people: all dat burden themselves wit it shall be cut in pieces, though all tha people of tha earth be gathered together against it.
In dat day, says tha LORD, I will strike every horse wit astonishment, N his rider wit madness: N I will open my eyes upon tha house of Judah, N will strike every horse of tha people wit blindness.
N tha governors of Judah shall say in their heart, tha inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in tha LORD of hosts their God.

In dat day shall tha LORD defend tha inhabitants of Jerusalem; N he dat is feeble among ’em at dat day shall be as David; N tha house of David shall be as God, as tha angel of tha LORD before ’em.
N it will happen in dat day, dat I will seek 2 destroy all tha nations dat come against Jerusalem.

N I will pour upon tha house of David, N upon tha inhabitants of Jerusalem, tha spirit of grace N of supplications: N dey shall look upon me whom dey have pierced, N dey shall mourn 4 him, as one mourns 4 his only son, N shall be in bitterness 4 him, as one dat is in bitterness 4 his firstborn.
In dat day shall there be a great mournin in Jerusalem, as tha mournin of Hadadrimmon in tha valley of Megiddon.
N tha land shall mourn, every family apart; tha family of tha house of David apart, N their wives apart; tha family of tha house of Nathan apart, N their wives apart;
Tha family of tha house of Levi apart, N their wives apart; tha family of Shimei apart, N their wives apart;
All tha families dat remain, every family apart, N their wives apart.

13.text: In dat day there shall be a fountain opened 2 tha house of David N 2 tha inhabitants of Jerusalem 4 sin N 4 uncleanness.

N it will happen in dat day, says tha LORD of hosts, dat I will cut off tha namez of tha idols out of tha land, N dey shall no more be remembered: N also I will cause tha prophets N tha unclean spirit 2 pass out of tha land.

N it will happen, dat when any shall yet prophesy, then his father N his mother dat fathered him shall say 2 him, u will not live; 4 u speak lies in tha name of tha LORD: N his father N his mother dat fathered him shall thrust him through when he prophesies.
N it will happen in dat day, dat tha prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he has prophesied; neither shall dey wear a rough garment 2 deceive:
But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; 4 man taught me 2 keep cattle from my youth.
N one shall say 2 him, What r dese wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, dose wit which I was wounded in tha house of my friends.
Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, N against tha man dat is my fellow, says tha LORD of hosts: strike tha shepherd, N tha sheep shall be scattered: N I will turn mine hand upon tha little ones.
N it will happen, dat in all tha land, says tha LORD, two parts in it shall be cut off N die; but tha third shall be left in it.
